A CNY 2 one-day trial exists with 1 core, 1 GB, 10 GB SSD and 1 GB of traffic. The page's third block offers further plans from CNY 25 a month without naming their shape. The vendor sells the same catalogue for Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Singapore, the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom.
